[b]The Horse part 1[/b]
It had been another long press day at the palace, the media buzzing and crying out about the unification and its effects on dairy prices in the small town of Lůda, indeed Erjk Drs hated these days, for the media was like a pack of wolves, always biting but never satisfied. 

He had finally retired to the private chambers of the palace, beyond the stern faces of his ancestors and into the more homely portion of the palace, where pictures of his children, his wife, and so on sat on small tables, and it smelled less like a palace and more like a small house. He sat in the sitting room of the place, a bowl of ramen in his lap, and the latest soap opera playing its dramatic tones loudly to absolutely no one, undisturbed he was.

Unfortunately as it is with such things, a knock roused him from his lazy state, and he was forced to answer it. Opening the door he came to see his advisor Edgar standing with an apologetic look upon his face.

My apologies your majesty, he began, catching the slight sneer upon Erjks face, But they insisted,.

Erjk sneered further, whomever [i]they[/i] were could wait, for it was surely that [i]they[/i] had not had the day that the Emperor  had.

After a few moments he gathered himself and replied to Edgar, Who is they?.

Edgar nodded and replied, The horse sir, the horse is here,.

It was with those words that Erjk understood who exactly it was that had come to see him.
